description: Buy 30 days of Pro (unlimited premium calls) for $29 in USDC, paid over x402 on Base. Without an X-API-Key it issues a new Pro key; with one it renews that key (a free key is upgraded in place), adding 30 days to its current end. The first call answers with the payment requirements; pay and retry with the X-PAYMENT header. The payment is taken only once the key is ready. No automatic refunds. If the answer says the payment could not be confirmed, do not pay again: quote its reference. How to pay: https://github.com/johnsmithxy1mmm-sys/HyperliquidMCP#pricing
